headline.purpose: Primary page h1; compact, strong, and tightly tracked.

section.purpose: Compact h2; panel-specific overrides remain local.

title.purpose: Default h3; 1.2rem at 700px and below unless locally overridden.

body.purpose: Manrope throughout; self-hosted, no external font service.

numeric.purpose: System monospace; tabular numerals for time and duration readouts.

shadows.name: dark-panel
shadows.purpose: Dark --shadow; tonal layering and borders supply depth.

shadows.name: editor-dialog
shadows.purpose: Editor dialog over a rgb(8 13 21 / 65%) backdrop.

motion.name: control-colors
motion.value: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Buttons and sidebar links only, under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Fixed blue and white in both themes; does not adopt dark --accent.
components.css: .ds-primary{font:600 .875rem/1.65 Manrope,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:9px 16px;background:#2563eb;color:white;border:1px solid #2563eb;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}.ds-primary:hover{background:#1d4ed8;border-color:#1d4ed8}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-primary{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Neutral surface with a quiet accent-soft hover.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font:600 .875rem/1.65 Manrope,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:9px 16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--accent-soft)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-secondary{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Danger button
components.description: Destructive semantic border and text, without changing confirmation behavior.
components.css: .ds-danger{font:600 .875rem/1.65 Manrope,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:9px 16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--danger);border:1px solid var(--danger);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}.ds-danger:hover{background:var(--danger-soft)}.ds-danger:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-danger:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-danger{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Visible label, fine outline, and theme-aware placeholder and caret.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-client-name">Tarayıcı adı</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-client-name" placeholder="Tarayıcı adı" />
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:block;font:600 .9375rem/1.65 Manrope,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:8px}.ds-field{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:44px;font:400 15px/1.65 Manrope,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);caret-color:var(--accent)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted);opacity:1}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Current navigation link
components.description: Active text/icon and blue left marker; compact mobile adaptation.
components.html: Genel Bakış
components.css: .ds-nav{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);font:600 .8125rem/1.65 Manrope,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-nav svg{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--muted)}.ds-nav:hover{background:var(--surface-soft)}.ds-nav[aria-current=page]{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:750}.ds-nav[aria-current=page] svg{color:inherit}.ds-nav[aria-current=page]::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:7px auto 7px 0;width:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent)}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-nav{padding:10px;font-size:.75rem;gap:8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-nav{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Connection status
components.description: Text-only semantic status; not a pill or chip.

components.name: Shared panel
components.description: Shared surface and divider vocabulary for summary and settings panels.

components.name: Pending panel
components.description: Screenshot-led task panel with intentional 4px accent edge.

narrative.northStar: A publishing workspace, not a social feed.
narrative.overview: Plain, modern, powerful: a blue/navy workspace for scanning task state and taking existing publishing actions. The seven user-approved `docs/design/*.png` references define the visual direction; `PRODUCT.md` defines the unchanged product. Unpictured pages use the same shell, panels, forms, and status language.
keyCharacteristics: Cool canvas, quiet panels, fine borders, and blue action cues.
Compact line icons, strong headings, and readable task-oriented density.
Light and dark appearances with the same hierarchy and interactions.

rules.name: The Solid Action Rule
rules.body: Keep primary buttons blue with white text in both themes; use the theme accent for links, focus, and active navigation.

dos: Do reuse the shared shell, panel, form, navigation, and status vocabulary on every page.
Do preserve existing actions, content, validation, permissions, confirmations, panel defaults, and live updates.
Do check both themes and narrow layouts, retaining visible keyboard focus and readable status text.
donts: Don't introduce social-media styling, invented metrics, decorative imagery, or new functionality.
Don't add fonts, UI dependencies, or speculative tokens to extend this visual system.
Don't remove the screenshot-led pending-panel accent edge or replace the fixed blue/white primary-button treatment.
